content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm new here and have a question regarding the [product_name] [article_no]. I'm working on a project that involves reading temperature from a room using a Johnson Controller and sending this data to a [product_name] [article_no]. It has worked well so far, but I've been asked to display the temperature values in my office, whereas the [product_name] is installed at a different location. I've heard that it's possible to transfer this information to my office via an Ethernet cable. Is there any software that allows me to view this temperature information on my office computer, just with the ethernet cable connected? I've only used LabVIEW before, and it doesn't seem to support PROFIBUS for this purpose. Thanks in advance [user_name]

Hello [user_name], You might want to look into [product_name] PC-Access, which provides an OPC server on your computer for monitoring variables, inputs, and outputs. It also allows you to transfer the values into Microsoft Excel. Regards,
Thanks a lot for your assistance, [user_name]. I'll give it a try and update you soon. Best Regards

I tried using PC Access, but it requires importing variables from a [product_name] project. I attempted to create variables in a test project, however, the client test was unsuccessful. What could be the issue? The same project works with [product_name] Advanced runtime and [product_name].

I resolved the issue. The problem was with the TSAP settings in PC Access. Setting TSAP 02.00 for both server and client made the client test function correctly. There's no need for [product_name], as items can be created manually without importing a file.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants are working on viewing temperature data remotely from a [product_name] module via Ethernet and a computer-based display solution. Initial user questions highlighted uncertainty about software that could showcase [product_name] data over Ethernet, especially since their prior toolkit (LabVIEW) and available hardware didn't support Profibus connectivity. The discussion included possible software applications and integration issues, which were overcome by adjusting communication parameters.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are looking for a straightforward way to monitor and display process data from the [product_name] module on a PC over Ethernet, with minimal setup and no need for additional programming or hardware modifications.
